notes: Written from the ingested docs. expected_urls are page URLs, with an anchor only where the answer lives in one section; a retrieved chunk matches when it is on the same page and (no anchor expected, or one of its heading anchors equals the expected anchor). refusal: forbidden = must answer, required = must refuse (not in the docs), either = version-sensitive question whose older version does not document the feature (a refusal or a 'not in this version' answer are both correct).

questions.question: How do I keep the splash screen visible while my app loads data?
questions.reference: Call SplashScreen.preventAutoHideAsync() early (outside a component), load resources, then call SplashScreen.hideAsync() once the app is ready.

questions.question: Where does expo-secure-store keep values on Android?
questions.reference: In SharedPreferences, encrypted with Android's Keystore system.

questions.question: Is data saved with expo-secure-store kept after the app is uninstalled?
questions.reference: Not on Android (removed on uninstall). On iOS the keychain data persists across reinstalls with the same bundle ID, but this is not guaranteed.

questions.question: How do I read EXPO_PUBLIC_ environment variables from a .env file in my app code?
questions.reference: Expo CLI loads variables prefixed EXPO_PUBLIC_ from .env files; define EXPO_PUBLIC_NAME=value and read process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_NAME in JavaScript.

questions.question: How do I protect screens so only signed-in users can see them in Expo Router?
questions.reference: Wrap the screens in Stack.Protected with a guard prop (for example guard={!!session}); when the guard is false the routes are inaccessible and the user is redirected.

questions.question: What does eas update:configure change in my project?
questions.reference: It adds runtimeVersion and updates.url to app.json (and extra.eas.projectId if needed) and sets the channel on the preview and production build profiles in eas.json.

questions.question: How do I use prepared statements with expo-sqlite?
questions.reference: Create one with db.prepareAsync(sql), run it with executeAsync(params) as many times as needed, and finalize it with finalizeAsync() when done.

questions.question: How do I open the camera with expo-image-picker and let the user crop the photo?
questions.reference: Call ImagePicker.launchCameraAsync({ allowsEditing: true, ... }) after requesting camera permission.

questions.question: How do I ask for permission to use the user's location while the app is open?
questions.reference: Call Location.requestForegroundPermissionsAsync() and check that status is granted before reading the position.

questions.question: How do I install EAS CLI and log in before my first build?
questions.reference: Install it globally with npm install -g eas-cli, then run eas login.

questions.question: What is Continuous Native Generation (CNG)?
questions.reference: A process where the native android and ios projects are generated on demand from app config and package.json (npx expo prebuild) instead of being checked in and edited by hand.

questions.question: How do I get push notification credentials for a development build?
questions.reference: Follow the setup guide's credentials step: for Android upload FCM V1 credentials, for iOS let EAS create a push key when building (eas credentials / eas build).

questions.question: How are EAS environment variables made available to EAS Build?
questions.reference: The build profile's environment (development, preview, production) selects which EAS environment's variables are loaded into the build job.

questions.question: How do I show a local notification immediately with expo-notifications?
questions.reference: Call Notifications.scheduleNotificationAsync({ content: {...}, trigger: null }); a null trigger shows it right away.

questions.question: What visibility settings can an EAS environment variable have?
questions.reference: Plain text, sensitive (obfuscated in logs) and secret (not readable outside EAS servers).

questions.question: What is a development build and why use it instead of Expo Go?
questions.reference: A debug build of your own app that includes expo-dev-client; unlike Expo Go it can contain any native code and config your app needs.

questions.question: How do I configure background location on iOS with expo-location?
questions.reference: Enable the background location mode (UIBackgroundModes location, via the config plugin's isIosBackgroundLocationEnabled option) and request background permission.

questions.question: How do I access the database from any component with useSQLiteContext?
questions.reference: Wrap the tree in SQLiteProvider with a databaseName, then call useSQLiteContext() in children to get the database instance.

questions.question: How do I regenerate the native android and ios folders from scratch?
questions.reference: Run npx expo prebuild --clean, which deletes and regenerates the native directories.

questions.question: How do I publish my Expo app to the Microsoft Windows Store?
questions.reference: Not covered: the Expo docs target Android, iOS and web.

questions.question: How do I build my Expo app for the PlayStation 5?
questions.reference: Not covered by the Expo docs.

questions.question: What is the monthly price of the Expo Enterprise plan in euros?
questions.reference: Not in the docs (pricing lives on the website, not in the docs).

questions.question: How do I enable right-to-left layout support with the expo-localization config plugin?
questions.reference: SDK 58 documents config plugin options supportsRTL (default true) and forcesRTL (default false), plus supportedLocales.

questions.question: How do I enable right-to-left layout support with the expo-localization config plugin?
questions.reference: SDK 57's page only shows adding the plugin; it documents no RTL options.

questions.question: How do I mark copied clipboard content as sensitive on Android?
questions.reference: Pass android: { isSensitive: true } to Clipboard.setStringAsync or setImageAsync.

questions.question: How do I mark copied clipboard content as sensitive on Android?
questions.reference: SDK 57's expo-clipboard docs do not document a sensitive flag.

questions.question: How do I open a downloaded file in the platform's native preview with expo-file-system?
questions.reference: Check file.canPreview(), then call file.preview({ title }) (Quick Look on iOS, an intent on Android).

questions.question: How do I open a downloaded file in the platform's native preview with expo-file-system?
questions.reference: SDK 57's expo-file-system docs have no file preview API.

questions.question: How do I set a large icon for Android notifications in the expo-notifications config plugin?
questions.reference: SDK 58 adds the largeIcon plugin property: a local image path, resized to 64x64 dp and shown next to the text.

questions.question: How do I set a large icon for Android notifications in the expo-notifications config plugin?
questions.reference: SDK 57's config plugin has icon and color but no largeIcon property.

questions.question: Which props does FlatList require to render a list?
questions.reference: renderItem and data are required; keyExtractor is commonly provided.

questions.question: How do I make a view readable as one element by screen readers?
questions.reference: Set accessible={true} (and an accessibilityLabel) so its children are grouped into one selectable element.

questions.question: How do I check in code whether the app is running on iOS or Android?
questions.reference: Use the Platform module: Platform.OS is 'ios' or 'android' (and Platform.select for per-platform values).

questions.question: How do I react to every change the user types into a TextInput?
questions.reference: Pass an onChangeText callback, which is called with the new text on every change.

questions.question: How do I get the window width and height and update when it changes?
questions.reference: Use the useWindowDimensions hook, which returns width and height and updates on changes.

questions.question: Which FlatList props help performance with long lists?
questions.reference: Tune removeClippedSubviews, maxToRenderPerBatch, updateCellsBatchingPeriod, initialNumToRender and windowSize; use getItemLayout and light list items.

questions.question: How do I open React Native DevTools?
questions.reference: Press j in the Metro terminal (or use the Dev Menu's Open DevTools).

questions.question: How should I define styles with StyleSheet.create?
questions.reference: Create a StyleSheet object with StyleSheet.create({...}) and reference its entries in the style prop; styles use camelCase names.

questions.question: How do I tell whether a screen reader is turned on?
questions.reference: Use AccessibilityInfo.isScreenReaderEnabled() and listen for the screenReaderChanged event.

questions.question: How do I build a Linux desktop app with GTK widgets in React Native?
questions.reference: Not covered by the React Native docs.
